065bebe8097d082f.description: Job Title: Associate Product Manager Shift: UK The Team Morningstars Analytics group develops and delivers proprietary methodologies, calculations, and analytical capabilities that help investors evaluate investments and make informed decisions. The Managed Investment Calculations team translates Morningstars research and intellectual property into accurate, scalable, and consistent analytics used across Morningstar products. The Role We are seeking a Associate Product Manager with strong business analysis and data analysis skills to lead the development and ongoing enhancement of managed investment calculation capabilities. This role combines product ownership with handson analytical work. You will partner with methodology experts, quantitative researchers, engineering, and quality assurance teams to translate investment methodologies and business needs into detailed calculation specifications and reliable production capabilities. You will analyze complex investment datasets, prototype and validate calculations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure that implementations faithfully reflect Morningstars proprietary methodologies. The ideal candidate brings analytical rigor, relevant investment knowledge, and the ability to learn complex financial concepts quickly. You should be comfortable both prioritizing a product backlog and using SQL to investigate underlying data. Prior knowledge of Morningstars products or methodologies is not required. Responsibilities Own product priorities and delivery: Manage the tactical roadmap and backlog for managed investment calculations, balancing new capabilities, methodology enhancements, data quality, and platform improvements. Define business requirements: Partner with product teams, research, operations, and client support to clarify user needs, assess business impact, and establish scope and success criteria. Translate methodologies into calculation specifications: Work with methodology owners to document formulas, input requirements, eligibility rules, calculation frequency, exceptions, and expected outputs. Perform detailed data and business analysis: Use SQL and analytical tools to investigate datasets, assess coverage and quality, map data sources, and understand dependencies and downstream impacts. Prototype and validate calculations: Develop calculation examples and independently verify results, including edge cases, missing data, historical changes, and differences across fund structures and share classes. Drive execution with engineering and QA: Develop actionable user stories and acceptance criteria, resolve implementation questions, and partner on test scenarios, regression coverage, and release readiness. Safeguard calculation quality: Investigate discrepancies and production issues, identify root causes, and prioritize fixes based on investor, client, and business impact. Manage methodology and implementation changes: Evaluate effects on historical results and consuming products, coordinate stakeholder review, and maintain traceability between approved methodologies and production logic. Build shared understanding: Maintain clear calculation documentation and support materials that help global teams explain analytics and resolve client questions. Measure outcomes and communicate progress: Track calculation accuracy, timeliness, coverage, and adoption, while communicating priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks. Required Qualifications 2+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or data analysis, preferably within investment analytics, financial data, or financial services. Strong handson SQL skills and experience analyzing complex datasets to validate results and investigate issues. Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business needs and financial methodologies into precise requirements, calculation logic, and acceptance criteria. Understanding of managed investments, including mutual funds, ETFs, share classes, and concepts such as investment performance, risk, fees, and peer group comparisons. Ability to learn complex financial concepts and methodologies quickly, question assumptions, and apply that understanding to data analysis and calculation requirements. Experience specifying, prototyping, or validating analytical calculations, with close attention to data dependencies, exceptions, and reproducibility. Experience prioritizing requirements or managing a backlog and collaborating with engineering and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle. Excellent critical thinking and problemsolving skills, including the ability to distinguish data issues from methodology or implementation issues. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to technical and business audiences. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across global teams. Bachelors degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science .

A business analysts uses data analytics to evaluate processes, identify requirements, and provide data-driven reports and suggestions to executives and stakeholders. This is crucial to bridging the gap between IT and the business. A thorough understanding of the "business analyst job description" is essential for anyone wishing to work in this exciting industry. An extensive summary of the "business analyst job description" will be given in this article, together with information on compensation expectations, critical skills, and essential tasks and responsibilities.

A business analyst plays a crucial role in an organization by liaising between IT teams and business stakeholders. Their primary responsibility is to use data analytics to comprehend corporate procedures, spot potential for development, and create plans to maximize production and efficiency.

Decision-makers receive insights and recommendations from business analysts, who also collect and analyze data and model company processes. They are essential in ensuring technology solutions align with corporate goals, making strategic planning and decision-making easier.

06665bc5d2e9518a.description: ### About Us Openigloo is on a mission to make renting fair, accessible, and transparent for all. We envision a world where renting is as easy as booking a hotel, where renters can research, apply, sign, and pay all in one place. We’re building a next-generation leasing marketplace that has supported over 2 million NYC renters with their apartment hunt. Learn more about openigloo at www.openigloo.com ### The Opportunity We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Product Engineer who can take product ideas from concept to production and build robust, scalable applications that deeply leverage modern AI. We are looking for an engineer who can work across the stack backend systems, frontend experiences, AI agents, tools, workflows, and infrastructure and combine them into reliable product used by real customers. As a core member of the team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the technical operations of the organization alongside the tech lead, CTO, and the CEO. The ideal candidate is highly product-minded, technically strong, AI-native, and comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You should be excited about using the latest AI capabilities while maintaining the engineering discipline required to build production-grade, observable, scalable, and maintainable systems. ### Qualifications - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. - 6+ years of experience in programming / software development. - Strong experience with Python/JavaScript/TypeScript etc. - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production applications. - Experience building applications using modern LLMs and AI APIs - Strong understanding of AI harness, agents, tool calling, agent orchestration, retrieval, context management, and LLM application architecture. - Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, observability, testing, and maintainable software architecture ### Key Responsibilities **What We Value:** - Is AI-native and actively experiments with new AI capabilities - Can move comfortably between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI systems. - Thinks about the customer and product outcome, not just the technical implementation. - Can independently take an ambiguous problem and drive it toward a working solution. - Moves quickly without sacrificing engineering quality. - Constantly looks for better architectures, tools, abstractions, and development practices **Collaboration and Communication:** - Collaborate with backend lead, CTO, and the CEO to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions. - Communicate technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders. **Continuous Improvement:** - Stay updated with the latest advancements in machine learning and AI technologies. ### Preferred Qualifications **DevOps Skills:** Familiarity with mobile CI/CD pipelines and to streamline mobile app deployment and updates. **AWS Knowledge:** Proficiency in using AWS services such as S3, ECS, and Lambda for static content management ### Why Join Us? - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. ### About Us openigloo is a marketplace that connects renters with highly-rated landlords. By combining crowdsourced tenant reviews with city data, renters can access information and browse available listings on any address in NYC. With a community of over 1.5+ million renters, our vision is to build a world where tenants everywhere can secure quality housing in just a few clicks. Learn more about openigloo at www.openigloo.com

0692ff35609a228f.description: About the job About Client - We are pioneering the Autopilot Enterprise. Our conversational AI agents handle workflows, drive outcomes, and deliver measurable impact for businesses. Born from the belief that enterprises need a new playbook, we build autonomous, multilingual agents capable of complex reasoning, contextual understanding, and end-to-end workflow ownership. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced ML Engineers (Senior) to drive the development of next-generation conversational and dynamic AI agents. You will architect and scale systems that enable: Conversational Agents (Voice & Chat): Human-like, open-ended dialogues without rigid workflow design. Dynamic reasoning to achieve goals (e.g., selling a personal loan). Continuous self-learning from conversation outcomes. Operating at minimal latency and cost. Dynamic Workflow Agents: Agents that learn workflows (Sales, Support, Admin) by observing humans. Self-learning from live agent behavior, recordings, and transcripts. Ability to see, process/understand, reason, and interact with GUIs/browsers. One-shot learning from escalations, ensuring accurate human-AI collaboration. Human agent assist & copilot features driven by workflow context. This is a rare opportunity to shape how enterprises adopt agentic AI, working directly at the intersection of AI research, applied ML, scalable infrastructure, and real-world enterprise workflows. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Vision Lead and mentor a team of engineers building agentic AI systems. Define technical vision, architecture, and product strategy. Architecture & Delivery Design and scale enterprise-grade AI products leveraging reinforcement learning, computer vision, and LLM fine-tuning. Drive low-latency, cost-optimized systems in production. Ensure robust engineering standards, testing, and security practices. Innovation & Integration Develop pipelines for self-learning agents from conversations and human workflows. Architect systems for human-in-the-loop escalation and AI copilots. Collaborate with product, design, and research teams to deliver real-world outcomes. Operational Excellence Establish CI/CD pipelines, automation, and best practices. Proactively identify risks and resolve technical challenges. Optimize for scalability, reliability, and enterprise integration. What We’re Looking For Experience: 2-8 years of experience. AI/ML Skills: Strong expertise in VOICE AGENT, Reinforcement Learning, Computer Vision, LLM fine-tuning, and applied ML research. Systems Expertise: Proven ability to build and scale large-scale distributed systems and enterprise-grade products. Infrastructure Skills: Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and scalable architecture. Hands-on Engineering: Proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or equivalent languages. Mindset: Passion for building product-first AI systems (not services), strong execution ability, and innovation-driven leadership. Why Join? Work at the cutting edge of AI and enterprise technology Be part of a mission-driven, high-growth startup Direct impact on products used by large-scale enterprise clients A vibrant and dynamic work environment fostering professional growth and innovation. Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. A front-row seat in the GenAI revolution, working with a team of passionate, like-minded innovators.
